newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian CPI up 0.53 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian CPI up 0.53 pct in June.

text.p: The Palestinian consumer price index (CPI) rose by 0.53 percent in June against 0.52 percent in May, the Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics (PCBS) said on Monday.
The PCBS said in a report Palestinian CPI had risen 7.22 percent since June 1996.
It said June's price rises were led by increases in recreational goods and services, medical care and household goods. Food costs declined slightly.
It said aggregate consumer prices increased by 0.74 percent in Arab East Jerusalem and by 0.19 percent in the Gaza Strip. Prices fell by 0.10 percent in the West Bank.
The PCBS, which began issuing data in November 1995, calculates prices in East Jerusalem, the Gaza Strip and the West Bank separately due to the geographic divisions between them.
The Palestinian Authority controls only parts of the West Bank and Gaza, while Israel controls East Jerusalem.
